# Terri Steffes

> A lifestyle blog by Terri Steffes covering home design, entertaining, recipes, books, and travel from a St. Louis-area perspective.

Our Good Life is a personal lifestyle blog focused on home renovation and interior design in the craftsman-style new urbanism tradition, complemented by entertaining ideas, recipes, book reviews, and lifestyle content. The site features both original content and sponsored partnerships with home and lifestyle brands.

## Key Topics

- Terri Steffes

## Home & Design

- [Making a Home](https://www.terristeffes.com/p/house-tour.html): House tour showcasing home renovation and interior design in Saint Charles and Jefferson City.
- [New Urbanism](https://www.terristeffes.com/p/decorating-projects.html): Home building and decorating projects featuring new urbanism design and craftsman-style construction.
- [Custom Kitchen Renovations Designed for Family Living](https://www.terristeffes.com/2026/03/custom-kitchen-renovations-designed-for.html): Kitchen renovation guide featuring functional layouts and storage solutions by Borowski Builders.
- [Why Accessible Features Help Residents Maintain Daily Independence](https://www.terristeffes.com/2026/03/why-accessible-features-help-residents.html): Guide to accessible housing features and universal design for aging in place and independence.
- [Smart Home Organization Before Leaving for a Long Trip](https://www.terristeffes.com/2026/03/smart-home-organization-before-leaving.html): Pre-trip checklist and smart home preparation guide using smart sensors and thermostats.

## Entertaining & Recipes

- [An Impromptu Brunch with MacKenzie Limited](https://www.terristeffes.com/2022/02/an-impromptu-brunch-with-mackenzie.html): Brunch party and table decor tips featuring Nora Fleming products and event planning ideas.
- [Ruth's Chris Patio Party #Thisishowitsdone](https://www.terristeffes.com/2015/06/ruths-chris-patio-party-thisishowitsdone.html): Restaurant review and event coverage of Ruth's Chris Steakhouse patio in Clayton, Missouri.
- [Elegant. Delicious. It's What's 4 Christmas. Beef.](https://www.terristeffes.com/2015/12/elegant-delicious-its-whats-4-christmas.html): Beef Wellington recipe using Certified Angus Beef and RoastPerfect app for holiday cooking.
- [#HotChocolateParty](https://www.terristeffes.com/2016/01/hotchocolateparty.html): Hot chocolate party ideas with creative cocktail recipes featuring Dove Chocolate and Rum Chata.
- [#asweetpairing](https://www.terristeffes.com/2016/02/asweetpairing.html): Chocolate popcorn and Josh wine pairing recipe for date nights and entertaining.

## Books & Reading

- [Book Review: Anna of Bethsaida by Susanne Blumer](https://www.terristeffes.com/2026/03/book-review-anna-of-bethsaida-by.html): Book review of Anna of Bethsaida by Susanne Blumer from The Arimathea Chronicles series.
